Pharmacokinetics

Mechanism of Action

Loop diuretics blocks NaKCl in the TAL of loop of Henle

Mechanism of Action 2

Loop diuretics enhance PG E2 and I2 synthesis

Therapeutic uses 1

Acute pulmonary edema

Therapeutic uses 2

Acute or chronic peripheral edema

Therapeutic uses 3

Acute or chronic renal failure

Therapeutic uses 4

Hypertensive emergencies

Therapeutic uses 5

Hypercalcemia

Adverse effects 1

Acute hypovolemia

Potassium depletion

Hypomagnesemia

Hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis

Adverse effects 2

Hyperuricemia

Adverse effects 3

Disturbed glucose metabolism and hyperlipidemia

Adverse effects 4

Ototoxicity

Adverse effects 5

Hypersensitivity
